diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all rollouts resulted in 'approved: true' and default meeting times (Tuesday afternoon) based only on shared facts S1-S4. The model is defaulting to approval and standard scheduling without encountering the constraints imposed by PF1 (teacher requirements) or PF2 (family obligations), meaning the hidden information is not yet necessary to drive a specific, non-default decision.
